implementation_overlay: Pre-existing 50 GiB guard-default working-tree changes are retained; exact file hashes below bind execution.
purpose: Test whether fixed general-knowledge replay repairs inherited fast-residual interference while preserving delayed associations and base-known noninterference. One bounded shared candidate with exposed diagnostic holdouts; no confirmatory retention claim or repeated audit tuning.
hypothesis: Two general replay examples per update will reduce fast-path interference while delayed value copying, original regression behavior and disabled-base outputs are preserved.
parent_role: Frozen accepted shared M3 candidate, enforced by path, report, protocol, manifest and weight hashes. E2 is only a historical initialization reference. Private is not selected. Parent baselines are recomputed with the corrected renderer.

dataset.role: 24 delayed training, 8 general replay training, 4 delayed development, 8 delayed diagnostic-holdout (4 seen-value, 2 novel-value, 2 changed-template), 8 original delayed regression, 2 general development and 4 general diagnostic-holdout. Development/regression/holdout rows never train or select thresholds. Holdouts are exposed diagnostics, not sealed confirmation.

depth_contract.writers: The two accepted independent SGDN-2 write encoders at blocks 13 and 27, further trained with the same shared convex reducer and source observations.
depth_contract.shared: For each observation chunk, evaluate both next-state proposals independently against one chunk-start state and publish their equal-weight convex mean once.
depth_contract.read_schedule: Observations are committed before delayed queries. Query, answer, generated continuation and future observations never enter writes.
depth_contract.state_accounting: One 65536-byte FP32 shared state matrix. No private deployment or capacity comparison is admitted.
depth_contract.compute_accounting: Two observation encodings and two SGDN-2 transition evaluations per chunk, two readers per action pass; record optimizer state, FP32 parameters, time, memory and artifacts.

training.feature_producer: Frozen native input-token embeddings of observed pages; original backbone remains frozen.
training.write_schedule: Delayed cases use two chunks; general replay uses one observed fact. No target or future text enters writes.
training.exposure_schedule: Two delayed and two replay examples per update. Delayed index stride 2 covers all 24 delayed cases in 32 exposures; replay index stride 2 covers all 8 replay cases in 32 exposures. Record unique IDs and counts by role.
training.optimizer_state: Int8 Muon momentum; trainable parameters and gradients FP32; auxiliary AdamW groups and state FP32. Record actual allocated state after final update.
training.loss: Response-only next-token cross entropy on answer plus EOS for delayed and general replay cases; prompt prefix masked. Store loss_sum and true per-example mean_loss.
training.selection: Empty record bank; only committed fast state supplies observations.
training.retention_replay: Eight general-knowledge training cases are interleaved, two per update. The diagnostic Paris/H2O cases and all development/regression/holdout rows remain outside training.

evaluation.adversarial_observation:
The deploy region for project Alder is cobalt.
The owner of project Alder is person01.
The launch code for project Alder is teal.
evaluation.renderer: Training and non-full-context evaluation both remove the observation placeholder. Full-context alone includes the observation for answerability.
evaluation.metric: Exact stripped answer by split, stratum, case role and control arm; preserve raw token IDs and parent/candidate pairs.
evaluation.correction: All twenty fresh+original delayed corrections; changed state and independently corrected expected answer where appropriate.
evaluation.general_noninterference: Correct replay-consistent state, unrelated/adversarial memory, zero, disabled, shuffled and full-context are separate. Require token-identical parent/candidate disabled-base outputs.
evaluation.same_process_restart: Save and reload the actual shared depth image with stable component version, owner/scope, lineage and counters; do not re-encode observations.
evaluation.original_diagnostic: If accepted, run eval_m3_retention.py with configs/m3_repair_original_check_v1.json against the original Paris/H2O cases. Require 2/2 correct for the triggering failure to count as repaired; otherwise retain an open-failure verdict.
evaluation.fresh_process_restart: If accepted, launch run_m3_restart.py against this exact protocol and candidate, answering fresh delayed held-out case one without observation encoding.

decision_rule.per_arm_accept: Correct fresh delayed held-out exact accuracy strictly above linear, shuffled, zero and disabled, with dev not below disabled; update-two first/later gradients nonzero for every depth; finite gradients and authenticated state/lineage/answer reload.
decision_rule.repair_accept: Fresh delayed held-out >= parent, original regression >= parent, final general correct > parent, general development correct >= parent, adversarial final/development >= parent, adversarial final >= disabled, and disabled-base token IDs identical between parent and candidate. All per-arm requirements must also pass.
decision_rule.original_failure_accept: Original Paris/H2O diagnostic 2/2 and fresh-process restart correct/equal after candidate freeze. These conditional gates are required for the final repaired verdict.
decision_rule.reject: No strict final-retention improvement, delayed/regression degradation, noninterference failure, or correct held-out not above controls.
decision_rule.defer: Engineering, gradient, restart, lineage or control-ambiguity failure.
decision_rule.no_promotion: Acceptance is a bounded diagnostic repair only. Exposed holdouts are not sealed confirmation, broad retention, general reasoning, RSI or production deployment evidence.

stop_conditions: wall-time, token, generation or artifact budget exceeded
source, target, future or unexpected producer content enters writes
dataset, parent, protocol or implementation hash mismatch
missing per-depth gradient coverage or state inventory
unauthenticated image/lineage or stale candidate restart
retention: Keep parent and candidate extensions, depth image, all raw parent/candidate answers, split/role/control metrics, exposures, gradients, optimizer audits, failures and guard traces. No base copy, download, remote push or default publication.
claims: One fixed-replay repair on exposed synthetic splits. No sealed confirmation, broad retention, general reasoning, RSI or production deployment claim.
